update.title: Academic Papers On Prediction Correction

content.text: Initial search query formed, aiming to find recent (post-2026-11) academic papers addressing prediction correction, utilizing the same observations for both correction and evaluation, while also focusing on evaluation methodologies. The goal is to understand the scope of existing results without introducing new evaluation protocols or baselines. The search is designed to specifically identify research comparing these evaluation approaches.

The evaluation's dependence on the same observations used for correction raises a potential for zero error, failing to reflect performance on other data. The search will therefore target literature discussing this evaluation dependency, focusing on the distinction between in-sample and out-of-sample error, rather than assuming an unresolved research problem or performance novelty. Research will also include discussions on bias correction and conformal prediction.
